sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: When Harry Rees was in middle school, he cared what his classmates thought of him.
sentences.zh: 当哈里·里斯上初中时，他在乎同学们对他的看法。

sentences.en: Now, all middle schoolers want to fit in with their peers.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有初中生都想融入同龄人之中。

sentences.en: But Harry, he was next level.
sentences.zh: 但哈里不一样，他是另一个级别。

sentences.en: I was somewhat insecure as an adolescent,
sentences.zh: 我年少时有点缺乏安全感，

sentences.en: very unsure of my standing within the social group that I lived in.
sentences.zh: 对自己在我所处的社交圈子里的地位非常不确定。

sentences.en: And I would keep daily charts of how I was doing and who I connected with
sentences.zh: 我会用日记图表记录我表现得怎么样，以及我和谁建立了联系，

sentences.en: and who I did not connect with.
sentences.zh: 和谁没有建立联系。

sentences.en: Harry's charts did more than track who sat next to him at lunch
sentences.zh: 哈里的图表不仅仅是追踪谁午饭时坐在他旁边，

sentences.en: or who joked around with him in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 或者谁在走廊里跟他开玩笑。

sentences.en: No, this is actually more embarrassing than that.
sentences.zh: 不，这其实比那还要尴尬。

sentences.en: These were actually graphs where I would rate on a 10-point scale
sentences.zh: 这些其实是图表，我会在上面用 10 分制来评估，

sentences.en: how I had done with various people on that day.
sentences.zh: 我那天和各种人相处得怎么样。

sentences.en: So if I thought that a certain person had really liked me on that day,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我认为某个特定的人那天真的很喜欢我，

sentences.en: you know, they would get a 9.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们会得 9 分。

sentences.en: And if I thought I had really come across as an idiot with another person,
sentences.zh: 而如果我认为自己在另一个人面前表现得像个白痴，

sentences.en: that might be a 2 or a 3.
sentences.zh: 那可能就是 2 分或 3 分。

sentences.en: And I would have these charts over time where the lines would go up and down.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，我会保留这些图表，上面的线条会上下波动。

sentences.en: It was a painful way to go through middle school.
sentences.zh: 那是一段痛苦的初中生活经历。

sentences.en: But it did come with an upside.
sentences.zh: 但它确实也有积极的一面。

sentences.en: Years later, Harry learned there were people who kept such charts professionally.
sentences.zh: 多年后，哈里得知有人专门以制作这种图表为职业。

sentences.en: I discovered, oh my God, there are people who actually make a life of studying this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我发现，天哪，真有人以研究这玩意儿为生。

sentences.en: And it just instantly grabbed me because it was something that I had always been doing.
sentences.zh: 它立刻吸引了我，因为这正是我一直在做的事。

sentences.en: Harry went on to become a social psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 哈里后来成了一名社会心理学家。

sentences.en: And he discovered that if you keep meticulous charts,
sentences.zh: 他发现，如果你做细致的图表，

sentences.en: if you track the ups and downs of relationships like an insecure middle schooler,
sentences.zh: 如果你像一个缺乏安全感的初中生一样追踪人际关系的起伏，

sentences.en: you can actually discover really interesting things
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以发现非常有趣的事情，

sentences.en: about the ebb and flow of human relationships.
sentences.zh: 关于人际关系的潮起潮落。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we conclude our Relationships 2.0 series
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”节目中，我们将结束“人际关系 2.0”系列，

sentences.en: with a look at the secret ingredient that makes some relationships thrive and others falter.
sentences.zh: 探讨让某些人际关系蓬勃发展而另一些关系走向破裂的秘密成分。

sentences.en: Many of us know what it's like to meet a soulmate or kindred spirit at work.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人都知道在工作中遇到灵魂伴侣或志同道合者的感觉。

sentences.en: We know what it feels like to be inspired by a politician or a business leader.
sentences.zh: 我们知道被政治家或商业领袖激励是什么感觉。

sentences.en: But what exactly prompts us to feel this deep connection with some people,
sentences.zh: 但究竟是什么促使我们对某些人产生这种深厚的联系，

sentences.en: but not with others?
sentences.zh: 而对另一些人却没有呢？

sentences.en: Is it having a shared goal, the intangibles of chemistry?
sentences.zh: 是因为有共同的目标，还是化学反应中那些说不清道不明的东西？

sentences.en: Or does it have to do with temperament and personality?
sentences.zh: 或者这与气质和性格有关？

sentences.en: It turns out that beneath the feeling of being close to someone
sentences.zh: 事实证明，亲近感之下的，

sentences.en: is a powerful psychological mechanism.
sentences.zh: 是一个强大的心理机制。

sentences.en: At the University of Rochester,
sentences.zh: 在罗切斯特大学，

sentences.en: psychologist Harry Rees has studied this core ingredient of successful relationships.
sentences.zh: 心理学家哈里·里斯一直在研究成功人际关系的这一核心成分。

sentences.en: Harry Rees, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 哈里·里斯，欢迎来到“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: Glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: I want to start by spending some time talking about a relationship in your own life, Harry.
sentences.zh: 哈里，我想先花点时间聊聊你生活中的一段人际关系。

sentences.en: I think it speaks to some of the research insights you've developed over the years.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映了你多年来开发的一些研究见解。

sentences.en: I understand you grew up in a very tight-knit community.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你是在一个非常紧密的社区中长大的。

sentences.en: You got married very young to a woman who was also from that same community.
sentences.zh: 你很早就结婚了，妻子也来自同一个社区。

sentences.en: What was that relationship like when you first got married?
sentences.zh: 你们刚结婚时，那段关系是怎样的？

sentences.en: You know, we grew up in a German-Jewish community in the upper parts of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们在曼哈顿上城区的一个德裔犹太人社区长大。

sentences.en: And the community was very insular.
sentences.zh: 那个社区非常封闭。

sentences.en: It was very warm and connected.
sentences.zh: 它非常温暖且联系紧密。

sentences.en: But there was also a sense that you would stay in that community
sentences.zh: 但同时也有这样一种观念：当你长大、结婚、

sentences.en: when you got older, when you got married, and began to raise children on your own.
sentences.zh: 开始自己抚养孩子时，你会留在那个社区里。

sentences.en: And so I had the expectation that I would find a partner in that group.
sentences.zh: 因此，我当时预期自己会在那个群体中找到伴侣。

sentences.en: And in fact, I did.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我也确实做到了。

sentences.en: I met my first wife when I was 19.
sentences.zh: 我 19 岁时遇到了我的第一任妻子。

sentences.en: She came from the same social community that I came from.
sentences.zh: 她和我来自同一个社交社区。

sentences.en: And we started dating largely because it was expected that you would start dating at that age.
sentences.zh: 我们开始约会，很大程度上是因为到了那个年纪大家都会开始约会。

sentences.en: All of my friends were doing it.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友们都在这么做。

sentences.en: All of my cousins were doing it.
sentences.zh: 我的表亲们也在这么做。

sentences.en: And so I did it.
sentences.zh: 所以我也这么做了。

sentences.en: And at the age of 21, we decided to get married.
sentences.zh: 在 21 岁的时候，我们决定结婚。

sentences.en: It was literally the exact day I graduated from college.
sentences.zh: 那正好是我大学毕业的那一天。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That was the age in which all of our parents had gotten married, you know, in the old country.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们所有人的父母在老家结婚的年龄，你知道的。

sentences.en: So that was what was expected.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是理所当然的期望。

sentences.en: At a certain point in your early adulthood, I think this was around the time you were in graduate school,
sentences.zh: 在成年早期的一段特定时间，我想大约是在你读研究生的时候，

sentences.en: you got involved in what were known at the time as encounter groups or encounter sessions.
sentences.zh: 你参与了当时被称为“遭遇小组”或“遭遇治疗”的活动。

sentences.en: For people who aren't familiar with that term today, can you describe what they were, Harry?
sentences.zh: 对于今天对这个词不熟悉的听众，你能描述一下它们是什么吗，哈里？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: And encounter groups were very popular in the late 1960s and 1970s.
sentences.zh: 遭遇小组在 20 世纪 60 年代末和 70 年代非常流行。

sentences.en: They were laboratories in which people could be completely open and honest,
sentences.zh: 它们就像是一个实验室，人们可以在其中完全开放和诚实，

sentences.en: talk about what they authentically felt, what their goals and needs were,
sentences.zh: 谈论他们的真实感受、他们的目标和需求，

sentences.en: and get honest feedback from other people about how they were coming across to them.
sentences.zh: 并从其他人那里获得关于他们给别人留下什么印象的诚实反馈。

sentences.en: Because there's so much of our natural social interaction that involves being polite,
sentences.zh: 因为我们许多自然的社交互动都涉及保持礼貌，

sentences.en: not really talking about what you're thinking and feeling.
sentences.zh: 并不真正谈论你的所思所想。

sentences.en: And the ground rules of these encounter groups were to be open and honest in everything that you said and did.
sentences.zh: 这些遭遇小组的基本规则就是在你所说和所做的一切中保持开放和诚实。

sentences.en: And did you say things in this group that you hadn't said before?
sentences.zh: 你在小组里说过以前没说过的话吗？

sentences.en: Did you reveal parts of yourself that you hadn't revealed to other people in your family growing up or to your wife?
sentences.zh: 你是否透露了自己从未向成长过程中的家人或妻子透露过的一部分？

sentences.en: Yes, I began to talk about how I saw my life, how I saw the community I came from,
sentences.zh: 是的，我开始谈论我是如何看待自己的人生，如何看待我出身的社区，

sentences.en: but also where I wanted to go with my life, what I wanted to accomplish professionally, but also personally.
sentences.zh: 还有我的人生走向，我在职业和个人方面想要达成什么成就。

sentences.en: And because I was in graduate school at NYU at the time, which was in Greenwich Village,
sentences.zh: 因为我当时在纽约大学读研究生，学校在格林威治村，

sentences.en: which of course was a very lively contemporary culture at the time,
sentences.zh: 那当然是当时一个非常活跃的当代文化中心，

sentences.en: and was beginning to experience the idea that the world I grew up in was not the world that I wanted to live my life in.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到，我长大的那个世界并不是我想要度过一生的世界。

sentences.en: But this was not something that I felt that I could talk about with my family or, for that matter, with my wife.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是我觉得可以和家人或者妻子谈论的事情。

sentences.en: And I began to talk about it in the context of the group and literally was blown away by the feedback that I got from other people.
sentences.zh: 我开始在小组的语境中谈论它，并且真的被其他人给我的反馈震撼到了。

sentences.en: So you were having these sessions in these encounter groups and learning, perhaps, parts of yourself,
sentences.zh: 所以你当时在参加这些遭遇小组的活动，并且或许了解到了自己的另一面，

sentences.en: learning things about yourself that you hadn't known before.
sentences.zh: 了解了以前不曾知道的关于自己的事情。

sentences.en: Were you able to bring this back to your marriage?
sentences.zh: 你能把这些带回你的婚姻中吗？

sentences.en: Were you able to talk with your wife about what was going on?
sentences.zh: 你能和妻子谈论发生的事情吗？

sentences.en: Did you have conversations about it?
sentences.zh: 你们有过这方面的对话吗？

sentences.en: And I'm wondering, if so, what they were like.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，如果有的话，它们是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, that was the problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题就在这里。

sentences.en: When I would begin to talk about these things, there was no recognition by my wife at all about what I was talking about.
sentences.zh: 当我开始谈论这些事情时，我的妻子根本无法理解我在说什么。

sentences.en: This was very contrary to what she knew about, what she had experienced,
sentences.zh: 这与她所了解、所经历的截然相反，

sentences.en: and there was just no connection there at all.
sentences.zh: 彼此之间完全没有共鸣。

sentences.en: And so our relationship really became a very distant relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的关系真的变得非常疏远。

sentences.en: It was not hostile.
sentences.zh: 并非充满敌意。

sentences.en: She was not mean about it in any way.
sentences.zh: 她并没有在任何方面表现得很刻薄。

sentences.en: She simply couldn't connect with it.
sentences.zh: 她只是无法产生共鸣。

sentences.en: And in a very real sense, I was moving in a different direction,
sentences.zh: 在很真实的意义上，我在向不同的方向前进，

sentences.en: and that was a direction that she couldn't come along.
sentences.zh: 而那是她无法随之同行的方向。

sentences.en: So there's obviously some tension here between the kind of person you were, the encounter groups.
sentences.zh: 所以这里显然存在着某种张力，介于你原本的为人与遭遇小组之间。

sentences.en: You felt like, in some ways, this was the authentic Harry.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，你觉得这才是真正的哈里。

sentences.en: In some ways, you couldn't be that authentic person in your marriage.
sentences.zh: 但在某种程度上，你无法在婚姻中做那个真实的自己。

sentences.en: What effect did this have on your marriage, Harry?
sentences.zh: 这对你的婚姻产生了什么影响，哈里？

sentences.en: Well, it basically ended it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它基本上结束了这段婚姻。

sentences.en: Of course, it took a year or a year and a half for that to actually happen.
sentences.zh: 当然，这实际上花了一年或一年半的时间才发生。

sentences.en: But essentially, I began to experience my outside life as far more rewarding and far more meaningful
sentences.zh: 但本质上，我开始觉得我的外部生活远比和妻子在一起的生活，

sentences.en: than the life that I had with my wife.
sentences.zh: 更有回报、更有意义。

sentences.en: And so we began to spend less time together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始减少相处的时间。

sentences.en: Our time together would be more structured on formalities rather than the kind of intimacies that should go on in a marriage.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起的时间更多是建立在形式化的结构上，而不是婚姻中应有的亲密感。

sentences.en: The story that you're telling about your marriage is, I think, really revealing because it also matches what your research has been finding over the last several years.
sentences.zh: 我认为你讲述的关于你婚姻的故事非常具有启示意义，因为它也符合你过去几年研究发现的结果。

sentences.en: What is the relationship between the experience of being understood in an intimate relationship and the likelihood of success or failure of that relationship?
sentences.zh: 在亲密关系中，被理解的体验与该关系成功或失败的可能性之间有什么关系？

sentences.en: Understanding is one of the most important things that we want in our close relationships.
sentences.zh: 被理解是我们对亲密关系最重要的诉求之一。

sentences.en: This is actually true beyond the realm of close relationships, but especially in our most intimate relationships, marriages, our friendships,
sentences.zh: 这实际上不仅适用于亲密关系的范畴，尤其在我们的最亲密的伴侣关系、婚姻、友谊中，

sentences.en: our connections with our siblings and the rest of our family.
sentences.zh: 以及我们与兄弟姐妹和其余家人的联系中更是如此。

sentences.en: One of the most powerful things that we want is for there to be real understanding in those relationships that the people on the other side know who we are and are caring and validating and accepting of that person.
sentences.zh: 我们最渴望的强大诉求之一，就是在这些关系中获得真正的理解，即另一端的人了解我们是谁，并且关怀、验证和接纳那个真实的个体。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: I think when most people think of intimate relationships, they think about things like love or, you know, appreciation or stability.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数人想到亲密关系时，都会想到诸如爱、欣赏或稳定之类的事情。

sentences.en: But, of course, the moment you say this, it makes intuitive sense to me that wanting to be understood is absolutely core to intimate relationships.
sentences.zh: 但当然，你一说出这个，我直觉上就明白，渴望被理解绝对是亲密关系的核心。

sentences.en: Well, I think the important point is that things like love and trust and caring simply don't work if there isn't understanding.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为重要的一点在于，如果没有理解，爱、信任和关怀这些东西根本无法发挥作用。

sentences.en: If your understanding of me is different than how I understand myself, then when you tell me how much you love me, you're telling me that you love somebody different than me.
sentences.zh: 如果你对我的理解与我对自己的理解不同，那么当你告诉我你有多爱我时，你其实是在告诉我你爱的是另一个不同于我的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And if I tell you how much I appreciate you, but, in fact, I'm appreciating you for the things that you're not, you don't think are the most important things about yourself,
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉你我有多么感激你，但事实上，我感激的却是你并非如此、你也不认为对自己而言最重要的事情，

sentences.en: some of my feedback will now start to sound inauthentic to you.
sentences.zh: 那么我的一些反馈对你来说听起来就会变得虚伪。

sentences.en: And, in fact, we have done research where we did exactly that, and a very interesting thing happens.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们做过这方面的研究，我们确实做了这样的实验，结果非常有趣。

sentences.en: People smile, they say they're happy to get the feedback,
sentences.zh: 人们微笑着，说很高兴能得到反馈，

sentences.en: and then they want to get out of there as fast as possible in case the other person finds out how false the impression was.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就想以最快速度离开，以免别人发现这种印象有多么虚假。

sentences.en: So, it feels inauthentic and very unrewarding.
sentences.zh: 所以，这感觉很不真实，也毫无收获。

sentences.en: Suppose you got a nice big raise at work from your boss, and they said they're giving you the raise because of something that isn't true about you.
sentences.zh: 假设你在工作中从老板那里得到了丰厚的加薪，而他们说给你加薪的原因却并不符合你的实际情况。

sentences.en: You know, think about how uncomfortable that would feel.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，想想那种感觉会有多尴尬。

sentences.en: Yeah, it makes you feel like an imposter almoSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，这几乎让你觉得自己是个冒名顶替者。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: The moment I heard about Harry's work, I started to see its applications everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我一听说哈里的工作，就开始发现它的应用无处不在。

sentences.en: Think about the perennial conflict between parents and children.
sentences.zh: 想想父母与孩子之间永恒的冲突。

sentences.en: So much of it can be traced to the feeling many kids have that their parents just don't get them.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分都可以追溯到许多孩子的一种感觉，即他们的父母根本不理解他们。

sentences.en: Take the opening scene of the movie Lady Bird.
sentences.zh: 以电影《伯德小姐》的开场白为例。

sentences.en: A teenager and her mom are driving back from a college tour, and they start to squabble.
sentences.zh: 一个十几岁的女孩和她的妈妈从大学参观之旅中开车返回，然后她们开始拌嘴。

sentences.en: I wish I could live through something.
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己能经历点什么。

sentences.en: Aren't you?
sentences.zh: 你不是吗？

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 才不是呢。

sentences.en: The only exciting thing about 2002 is that it's a palindrome.
sentences.zh: 2002年唯一令人兴奋的事就是它是个回文数。

sentences.en: Okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧，行。

sentences.en: Well, yours is the worst life of all, so you win.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你的生活才是所有人中最糟的，所以你赢了。

sentences.en: Oh, so now you're mad?
sentences.zh: 哦，所以现在你生气了？

sentences.en: No, it's just you're being ridiculous because you have a great life.
sentences.zh: 不，只是你在无理取闹，因为你过着很棒的生活。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I'm not perfect.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我不是完美的。

sentences.en: No one's asking you to be perfect.
sentences.zh: 没人要求你完美。

sentences.en: Just consider it would do.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下就行了。

sentences.en: I don't even want to go to school in this state anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正我这种状态下连学校都不想去了。

sentences.en: No, I was happy to have my sink cleaned.
sentences.zh: 不，有人帮我清理洗手池，我挺高兴的。

sentences.en: One of the things I'm taking away from all this work, Harry, is that, you know, being
sentences.zh: 哈里，从所有这些研究中我得出的结论之一，就是

sentences.en: understood requires significant effort from two parties.
sentences.zh: 被理解需要双方付出巨大的努力。

sentences.en: So understanding tends to happen when you have an excellent communicator paired with an
sentences.zh: 因此，只有当一个极佳的沟通者和一个

sentences.en: excellent empath.
sentences.zh: 极佳的共情者相遇时，理解才更有可能发生。

sentences.en: And of course, when you put it that way, it becomes much less surprising that so many of
sentences.zh: 当然，当你这样表述时，我们会发现，我们当中有那么多人

sentences.en: us go through life without getting the understanding that we want or without extending understanding
sentences.zh: 一生都在渴望理解却求而不得，或者从未向他人

sentences.en: to others.
sentences.zh: 给予理解，这其实也就没那么令人意外了。

sentences.en: Yes, that's correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: A failure on either end of that transaction can make it go bad.
sentences.zh: 这段互动中任何一端的失败都会导致结果变糟。

sentences.en: Can you talk for a moment about the experience of getting this understanding, given that it's
sentences.zh: 鉴于获得这种理解非常难得，

sentences.en: rare, given that it doesn't happen always?
sentences.zh: 鉴于它并非时常发生，你能谈谈获得这种理解的体验吗？

sentences.en: I think many of us have a feeling of almost transcendence when we feel like we are paired
sentences.zh: 我想我们许多人在觉得自己遇到

sentences.en: with someone who truly gets us.
sentences.zh: 真正懂自己的人时，都会有一种近乎超越的感受。

sentences.en: Well, I would not quite want to go as far as you're going and saying that we don't have
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可能不会像你那样走得那么远，去说我们完全没有

sentences.en: this kind of understanding.
sentences.zh: 这种理解。

sentences.en: We certainly don't have this kind of complete understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们当然没有这种完全彻底的理解。

sentences.en: But if we didn't have some level of understanding, we would all be deflecting and bouncing off
sentences.zh: 但如果我们连某种程度的理解都没有，我们在许多方面

sentences.en: each other in many ways.
sentences.zh: 就会一直在互相回避和碰撞。

sentences.en: So there's some level of basic understanding that is quite common in our lives.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们的生活中，某种程度的基本理解是非常普遍的。

sentences.en: And for that to happen, we have to be reasonably open in expressing what's important to us and reasonably good listeners in paying attention to what's being said to us.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一点，我们必须相当开放地表达对我们重要的事情，并且做优秀的倾听者，用心去关注别人对我们说的话。

sentences.en: When we come back, a curious twiSt.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，我们将迎来一个奇妙的转折。

sentences.en: It turns out there is a big difference between being understood and feeling understood.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，被理解和感到被理解之间存在着巨大的差异。

sentences.en: Also, given the barriers we face to understanding, what skills can help us become more connected
sentences.zh: 此外，鉴于我们在理解上面临种种障碍，有哪些技巧能帮助我们与他人建立更深的联系

sentences.en: to others and allow us to understand them a little better.
sentences.zh: 并让我们更好地理解他们？

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: The desire to feel understood appears to be a core psychological need.
sentences.zh: 渴望被理解似乎是一项核心的心理需求。

sentences.en: When we have it, we are happier colleagues, warmer partners, and more loyal friends.
sentences.zh: 当我们拥有这种感觉时，我们会成为更快乐的同事、更温暖的伴侣以及更忠诚的朋友。

sentences.en: When we don't feel understood, it can corrode even our best relationships.
sentences.zh: 当我们感到不被理解时，它甚至会侵蚀我们最好的关系。

sentences.en: Psychologist Harry Rees studies intimate relationships.
sentences.zh: 心理学家哈里·里斯专门研究亲密关系。

sentences.en: He's found that being understood is a pillar of successful relationships.
sentences.zh: 他发现，被理解是成功关系的基石。

sentences.en: But there are all kinds of cognitive biases that keep us from being understood and keep us from understanding others.
sentences.zh: 但各种各样的认知偏差阻碍了我们被理解，也阻碍了我们去理解他人。

sentences.en: Harry, one of the most interesting aspects of your research is that you found a difference between being understood and feeling understood.
sentences.zh: 哈里，你的研究中最有趣的一个方面，就是你发现“被理解”和“感到被理解”之间存在差异。

sentences.en: Can you explain this difference to me?
sentences.zh: 你能向我解释一下这种差异吗？

sentences.en: Yes, being understood refers to whether you really understand what another person is like,
sentences.zh: 是的，“被理解”指的是你是否真的了解另一个人是什么样的，

sentences.en: what their preferences are, what their character traits are, what their needs are, what their desires are.
sentences.zh: 他们的偏好是什么，他们的性格特点是什么，他们的需求是什么，他们的渴望是什么。

sentences.en: Feeling understood, it's entirely within the mind of the perceiver,
sentences.zh: 而“感到被理解”完全存在于感知者的心中，

sentences.en: and it's the belief that another person really understands who you are and what's important to you.
sentences.zh: 它是指一个人相信另一个人真正理解了他是谁以及什么对他是重要的。

sentences.en: And you're saying that there are sometimes cases where people may feel understood without actually being understood?
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，有时会出现人们并没有真正被理解、却觉得自己被理解了的情况？

sentences.en: Yes, there are.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: One of the things we've found in our work is that when people have successful relationships,
sentences.zh: 我们在研究中发现的一点是，当人们拥有成功的关系时，

sentences.en: they often imagine that other people understand them better than they actually do.
sentences.zh: 他们往往会想象别人对他们的理解比实际情况要好。

sentences.en: And this is one thing that actually helps them maintain a sense of security and safety in that relationship.
sentences.zh: 而这正是帮助他们在这种关系中维持安全感和稳固感的一个因素。

sentences.en: And you've done studies to this effect, I understand, where you show that in some ways the belief that you are understood,
sentences.zh: 据我所知，你曾为此做过研究，表明在某些方面，你认为自己被理解的信念，

sentences.en: the feeling that you have of being understood, in fact, is a strong predictor of the success of that relationship,
sentences.zh: 你所感受到的被理解的感觉，事实上是关系成功的一个强有力预测指标，

sentences.en: not necessarily the fact that people actually are understood.
sentences.zh: 而并不一定是人们实际上被理解了这一事实。

sentences.en: Yes, that's correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Well, what we did in this work was look at the extent to which people felt understood by their close relationship partners in two different areas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在研究中做的是，观察人们在两个不同领域中感到被亲密伴侣理解的程度。

sentences.en: One is in the area of sexual preferences, and the other was in the area of humor preferences.
sentences.zh: 一个是性偏好领域，另一个是幽默偏好领域。

sentences.en: And what we found was quite interesting, and that's that when people feel very satisfied with their relationships
sentences.zh: 我们发现的情况非常有趣：当人们对自己的关系感到非常满意，

sentences.en: and when they feel very similar to the people that they're relating to,
sentences.zh: 并且当他们觉得与交往对象非常相似时，

sentences.en: they actually imagine that there's a greater level of understanding than there actually is.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上会想象出比实际更高的理解水平。

sentences.en: Now, this is a good thing, because that greater level of feeling understood allows them to feel more confident, more safe, more happy in the relationship.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一件好事，因为这种更高程度的“感到被理解”能让他们在关系中感到更加自信、安全和幸福。

sentences.en: So we talk about this as a maintenance mechanism, and by that we mean a way of thinking about your relationship
sentences.zh: 所以我们把这称为一种维护机制，我们的意思是，这是一种看待你们关系的方式，

sentences.en: that actually boosts the integrity and the coherence and the safety of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 它实际上提升了关系的完整性、连贯性和安全感。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about this also in the context of politics.
sentences.zh: 我也在政治语境下思考过这个问题。

sentences.en: Politicians like, you know, Bill Clinton or Donald Trump, they're loved by their supporters in part because people feel like they understand them.
sentences.zh: 像比尔·克林顿或唐纳德·特朗普这样的政客，他们的支持者之所以深爱他们，部分原因在于人们觉得这些政客懂他们。

sentences.en: Is that stretching your research too far to extend it to the realm of politics?
sentences.zh: 把你的研究延伸到政治领域，是不是有点过度解读了？

sentences.en: No, I think that implication follows quite naturally.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为这种推论是相当自然的。

sentences.en: You know, both Bill Clinton and Donald Trump were able to communicate to other people something that made it sound like he really understood what was important to those people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比尔·克林顿和唐纳德·特朗普都能够向他人传达某些信息，听起来就像他真的理解了对这些人来说最重要的是什么。

sentences.en: And that is a major determinant of people's identification with candidates,
sentences.zh: 这是人们认同候选人的一大决定性因素，

sentences.en: their willingness to go out and vote for those candidates or perhaps to even donate to them.
sentences.zh: 决定了他们是否愿意出门投票给这些候选人，或者甚至为他们捐款。

sentences.en: In my state, when people lose their jobs, there's a good chance I'll know them by their names.
sentences.zh: 在我的州，当人们失业时，我很有可能会通过名字认识他们。

sentences.en: When a factory closes, I know the people who ran it.
sentences.zh: 当一家工厂关闭时，我认识经营它的人。

sentences.en: When the businesses go bankrupt, I know them.
sentences.zh: 当企业破产时，我认识他们。

sentences.en: People that have lost their jobs, lost their livelihood, lost their health insurance.
sentences.zh: 那些失去工作、失去生计、失去医疗保险的人。

sentences.en: What I want you to understand is...
sentences.zh: 我想让你们明白的是……

sentences.en: On the campaign, I called it the forgotten man and the forgotten woman.
sentences.zh: 在竞选活动中，我称他们为被遗忘的男人和被遗忘的女人。

sentences.en: And I think it might also be a measure of how much we are willing to forgive candidates,
sentences.zh: 我想这也可能衡量了我们愿意在多大程度上原谅候选人，

sentences.en: even if they fail to deliver on promises that they have made to us.
sentences.zh: 即使他们未能兑现对我们许下的诺言。

sentences.en: When we feel like the candidates understand us, that this leader truly gets us,
sentences.zh: 当我们觉得候选人理解我们，这位领导人真正懂我们，

sentences.en: this leader is perhaps even one of us,
sentences.zh: 这位领导人甚至可能就是我们中的一员时，

sentences.en: you're willing to forgive all kinds of things,
sentences.zh: 你就会愿意原谅各种各样的事情，

sentences.en: even if the candidate doesn't actually deliver once he or she is in office.
sentences.zh: 即使这位候选人在上台后实际上并没有兑现承诺。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为完全正确。

sentences.en: I want to turn to some of the techniques that we can use to better understand other people
sentences.zh: 我想转向一些我们可以用来更好地理解他人

sentences.en: and to be better understood by others.
sentences.zh: 以及被他人更好地理解的技术。

sentences.en: Psychotherapists sometimes use a technique called speaker-listener technique
sentences.zh: 心理治疗师有时会使用一种名为“说话者-倾听者”的技术

sentences.en: to help couples overcome misunderstandings.
sentences.zh: 来帮助伴侣克服误解。

sentences.en: Can you describe this technique to me, Harry?
sentences.zh: 哈里，你能给我描述一下这项技术吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The speaker-listener technique is a very straightforward way
sentences.zh: “说话者-倾听者”技术是一种非常直接的方法，

sentences.en: of trying to both enforce the idea of needing to listen,
sentences.zh: 旨在既强化需要倾听的理念，

sentences.en: but also to create the sense of being listened to.
sentences.zh: 又营造出一种正在被倾听的感受。

sentences.en: So in the speaker-listener technique,
sentences.zh: 所以在“说话者-倾听者”技术中，

sentences.en: there will be a box on the table with two red lights,
sentences.zh: 桌上会有一个盒子，上面有两个红灯，

sentences.en: one in front of each partner.
sentences.zh: 每个伴侣面前各一个。

sentences.en: And the way the process works is
sentences.zh: 这个过程的运作方式是：

sentences.en: only the partner who has the light is allowed to speak.
sentences.zh: 只有亮灯的那位伴侣才被允许说话。

sentences.en: So the light's on, you're allowed to speak,
sentences.zh: 所以灯亮着，你就可以说话，

sentences.en: and you can say whatever your concerns or issues are.
sentences.zh: 你可以说出你的任何担忧或问题。

sentences.en: Then the light switches,
sentences.zh: 然后灯光切换，

sentences.en: and the partner's job is to repeat what you just said as they heard it.
sentences.zh: 另一位伴侣的任务是按照自己听到的大意，重复你刚才说过的话。

sentences.en: Then the first person's light comes back on,
sentences.zh: 接着第一个人的灯重新亮起，

sentences.en: and that person then has to comment on whether you got it right
sentences.zh: 那个人必须对对方是否理解正确

sentences.en: or how you got it wrong.
sentences.zh: 或者在哪些地方理解错了做出评论。

sentences.en: And then the other person's light comes back on,
sentences.zh: 然后另一个人的灯再次亮起，

sentences.en: and they have to amend what they said
sentences.zh: 他们必须根据你刚才给出的反馈

sentences.en: to reflect the feedback that you just gave them.
sentences.zh: 来修正他们刚才所说的话。

sentences.en: So in some ways, you're slowing people down to the point
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，你是在把人们的节奏放慢，

sentences.en: where each side says,
sentences.zh: 慢到双方都说：

sentences.en: not only have I had my say,
sentences.zh: 不仅我已经把话说出来了，

sentences.en: I am now sure the other person has heard me
sentences.zh: 我现在也可以确信，对方确实按照我希望被听到

sentences.en: in exactly the way that I want to be heard.
sentences.zh: 的那种方式听到了我说的话。

sentences.en: Right, but it's more than just slowing down
sentences.zh: 对，但这不仅仅是放慢速度，

sentences.en: because lots of times people know that they have to shut up
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候人们知道在别人表达观点时自己必须闭嘴，

sentences.en: while the other person is saying their point of view,
sentences.zh: 但他们的内心其实是封闭的。

sentences.en: but their mind will be closed.
sentences.zh: 而这项技术强迫他们敞开心扉，

sentences.en: This technique forces them to open their minds
sentences.zh: 真正去聆听对方在说些什么。

sentences.en: and really listen to what's being said.
sentences.zh: 更深入的理解可能会带来哪些有益的影响，

sentences.en: What are the salutary effects
sentences.zh: 无论是对我们个人的心理，

sentences.en: that greater understanding might bring,
sentences.zh: 还是对我们对待他人方式的影响？

sentences.en: both in terms of our personal psychology,
sentences.zh: 是的，我们对此做过许多研究，

sentences.en: but also in the way we treat other people?
sentences.zh: 在研究中我们使用了实验操控手段，

sentences.en: Yes, we've done a number of studies of this
sentences.zh: 让人们暂时感到更加被理解，

sentences.en: where we use an experimental manipulation
sentences.zh: 或者相反地感到更加不被理解。

sentences.en: that will temporarily allow people to feel more understood
sentences.zh: 而我们发现，一旦我们让人们产生一种感觉，

sentences.en: or alternatively to feel more misunderstood.
sentences.zh: 即他们被理解了、

sentences.en: And what we find is that once we give people a sense
sentences.zh: 他们的价值得到了认可并且得到了回应，

sentences.en: that they've been understood,
sentences.zh: 他们就会变得更加开明，

sentences.en: that they've been validated and responded to,
sentences.zh: 更加愿意考虑相反的观点。

sentences.en: they become more open-minded,
sentences.zh: 这项研究是我与一位名叫盖伊·伊奇科夫的以色列同事共同完成的，

sentences.en: they become more willing to consider opposite points of view.
sentences.zh: 我们先让人们产生被理解的感觉，

sentences.en: This is work that I did with an Israeli colleague named Guy Itchikoff,
sentences.zh: 然后测量他们对某些他们可能了解的外部群体的偏见。

sentences.en: and we gave people a sense of being understood
sentences.zh: 也许是一个族群，

sentences.en: and then measured their prejudice toward some outgroup that they might have known.
sentences.zh: 也许是具有不同性取向的人群，

sentences.en: Perhaps it was an ethnic group.
sentences.zh: 总之是某种他们在研究开始前

sentences.en: Perhaps it was people with a different sexuality.
sentences.zh: 曾表现出一定负面情绪的群体。

sentences.en: Some group that prior to the study,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在感到被理解之后，

sentences.en: they had expressed some negativity toward.
sentences.zh: 他们不再那么执着于抬高自己对自己的看法，

sentences.en: And we found that after feeling understood,
sentences.zh: 不再以那种更能增强自我优越感的方式来思考自己。

sentences.en: they become less concerned with inflating their view of themselves,
sentences.zh: 而最重要、也最有趣的是，

sentences.en: of thinking of themselves in a more ego-enhancing way.
sentences.zh: 最重要、最有趣的是，

sentences.en: And most importantly, and most interestingly,
sentences.zh: 最重要、最有趣的是，

sentences.en: they become less prejudiced towards outgroups.
sentences.zh: 他们对外部群体的偏见会减少。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if you can tell me a little bit
sentences.zh: 我想请教你一个问题

sentences.en: about some of the techniques that you employ yourself,
sentences.zh: 关于你自己采用的一些技巧，

sentences.en: having done this work for many years
sentences.zh: 因为你从事这项工作很多年了

sentences.en: after seeing the importance of actual understanding
sentences.zh: 在看到真正理解的重要性之后

sentences.en: as well as communicating understanding to other people.
sentences.zh: 以及向其他人传达理解的重要性。

sentences.en: How has this changed the way you interact with others
sentences.zh: 这如何改变了你与他人互动的方式

sentences.en: in terms of your students, your colleagues,
sentences.zh: 就你的学生、你的同事而言，

sentences.en: your partners, your friends, your family?
sentences.zh: 你的伴侣、你的朋友、你的家人？

sentences.en: Do you do things differently today than you did in the past?
sentences.zh: 你现在的做法和过去有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: One of the things I do, particularly with students,
sentences.zh: 我做的事情之一，特别是对学生而言，

sentences.en: is that students will often come to you
sentences.zh: 就是学生经常会来找你

sentences.en: with a request for this, that, or the other thing.
sentences.zh: 提出这样、那样或别的什么要求。

sentences.en: And often, it's not a request that we can grant.
sentences.zh: 而且通常，这不是我们能答应的要求。

sentences.en: And rather than just say, no, sorry,
sentences.zh: 与其直接说，不，对不起，

sentences.en: I will sort of go out of my way
sentences.zh: 我会特意

sentences.en: to make it clear that I understood what they said.
sentences.zh: 让他们清楚我理解了他们的话。

sentences.en: I think it's a perfectly reasonable thing
sentences.zh: 我认为这是完全合理的要求

sentences.en: for them to ask for, but I just can't do it.
sentences.zh: 他们这样要求，但我就是做不到。

sentences.en: They may feel turned down,
sentences.zh: 他们可能会觉得被拒绝了，

sentences.en: but at least they know that I paid attention
sentences.zh: 但至少他们知道我注意到了

sentences.en: and respected where they were coming from.
sentences.zh: 并且尊重他们的立场。

sentences.en: I want to stay with that insight for a moment,
sentences.zh: 我想在这个洞察上停留一会儿，

sentences.en: because in some ways,
sentences.zh: 因为从某种意义上说，

sentences.en: I think what you're hinting at, at least,
sentences.zh: 我认为你至少暗示了这一点，

sentences.en: is that sometimes the pain we feel in disagreements
sentences.zh: 有时我们在分歧中感受到的痛苦

sentences.en: might be less about the disagreement,
sentences.zh: 可能不那么源于分歧本身，

sentences.en: and it might be more about how we feel
sentences.zh: 而更多地源于我们觉得

sentences.en: the other person has heard us or listened to us
sentences.zh: 对方是如何倾听我们的、听取我们的意见

sentences.en: or taken us seriously.
sentences.zh: 或者是否把我们当回事。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: There is research by one of my colleagues, Amy Gordon,
sentences.zh: 我的同事艾米·戈登做过一项研究，

sentences.en: where she has shown that conflicts,
sentences.zh: 她表明冲突，

sentences.en: even when they don't get resolved,
sentences.zh: 即使没有得到解决，

sentences.en: are less harmful to relationships
sentences.zh: 对关系的损害也会减小

sentences.en: when people feel like they've been heard and understood.
sentences.zh: 当人们觉得自己被倾听和理解时。

sentences.en: One of the misconceptions that people have
sentences.zh: 人们的一个误解是

sentences.en: is that if you express understanding
sentences.zh: 如果你表达了理解

sentences.en: for what the other person is saying,
sentences.zh: 对于对方所说的话，

sentences.en: that you're somehow agreeing with their point of view,
sentences.zh: 就好像你在某种程度上同意他们的观点，

sentences.en: and that needn't be the case.
sentences.zh: 而事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Understanding simply means making it clear
sentences.zh: 理解仅仅意味着让人明白

sentences.en: that you get the message that they communicated
sentences.zh: 你收到了他们传达的信息

sentences.en: and that you respect it as a reasonable point of view.
sentences.zh: 并且你将其视为一个合理的观点予以尊重。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that you have to agree with it.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你必须赞同它。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But it's worth flagging.
sentences.zh: 但这是值得指出的。

sentences.en: The reason that I think many of us fail to do this,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们很多人做不到这一点的原因，

sentences.en: fail to understand others,
sentences.zh: 无法理解他人，

sentences.en: or fail to have ourselves be understood,
sentences.zh: 或者无法让别人理解自己，

sentences.en: is it actually is it's hard.
sentences.zh: 是因为它确实很难。

sentences.en: It does involve time, it involves effort,
sentences.zh: 它确实需要时间，需要付出努力，

sentences.en: and it involves emotional effort.
sentences.zh: 而且需要情感上的努力。

sentences.en: And it also involves vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 它还需要脆弱性。

sentences.en: It involves being open to hearing something
sentences.zh: 它需要敞开心扉去听一些

sentences.en: that you might not like.
sentences.zh: 你可能并不喜欢的话。

sentences.en: So in some ways, the act of doing this
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，这样做

sentences.en: involves, you know, an element of courage, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我想包含了一种勇气元素。

sentences.en: It definitely involves courage.
sentences.zh: 它绝对需要勇气。

sentences.en: The courage to tell you who I really am,
sentences.zh: 向你展现真实自我的勇气，

sentences.en: and the courage to listen to who you really are.
sentences.zh: 以及倾听真实你的勇气。
